nodes.title: The Throne Room
nodes.text:
You reek of fraud and dried moat-shit. The King sits on his throne, beaming at you.

"Sir Coward, the realm sings of your bravery! Driving off the Dreadwyrm with nothing but a rusty spoon! Now, take this 500 gold expedition fund, march to its lair, and bring me its head."

You nod, sweating profusely. You are totally fucked. You leave the castle with a heavy coin purse.

choices.label: Stride to the Royal Armorer to bluff your way into enchanted gear
Head to the Rusty Flagon to hire a psychopath to do the dying for you
Fuck the dragon. Take the 500 gold and make a break for the docks

nodes.title: The Royal Armorer
nodes.text:
The Armorer squints at you. "The dragonslayer. You don't look that tough up close."

He guards the King's finest stash, including the legendary Dragonbane Lance.

choices.label: Puff out your chest. "Do you want to explain to the King why his champion fought bare-handed?"
Break down crying and offer him 200 gold to just give you something shiny
Stutter and trip over your own scabbard

nodes.title: Armed and Dangerous
nodes.text:
The Armorer pales. "My apologies, my lord!" He hands you the glowing Dragonbane Lance. It hums with lethal, ancient power. You feel 10% less likely to shit yourself.

You hit the road.

choices.label: March toward the Dragon's Mountain

nodes.title: Pay to Win
nodes.text:
He snatches the gold and tosses you a set of heavy, flame-retardant plate armor. "We never spoke," he grunts.

You head out with 300 gold left and armor too heavy for your frail frame.

choices.label: Waddle toward the Dragon's Mountain

nodes.title: The Jig is Up
nodes.text:
The Armorer crosses his arms. "You're full of shit. The real hero was seven feet tall."

He signals the Royal Guards.

choices.label: Try to run

nodes.title: The Rusty Flagon
nodes.text: The tavern smells of cheap ale and expensive violence. In the corner sits Bronn the Cutthroat, a mercenary who has killed men for looking at his soup wrong.

choices.label: Offer him 300 gold to kill the dragon while you watch
Get drunk instead to calm your nerves

nodes.title: The Muscle
nodes.text:
Bronn bites the gold coins, grunts, and readies his greatsword. "Lead the way, 'hero'."

You hit the road, safely hiding behind him.

choices.label: March to the Dragon's Mountain

nodes.title: A Bad Start
nodes.text:
You spend 50 gold on black-market rum. You wake up in a ditch 12 hours later with a splitting headache, no mercenary, and only 450 gold.

Time to go.

choices.label: Stumble toward the Dragon's Mountain

nodes.title: The Coward's Run
nodes.text: You sprint to the docks. A smuggler's galleon is prepping to sail for the Summer Isles, where they don't have dragons, only coconuts.

choices.label: Bribe the captain with all 500 gold for passage
Try to sneak aboard inside a barrel

nodes.title: Bad Cargo
nodes.text: The crew finds you. They strip you of your gold and hand you over to the Harbor Patrol as a stowaway.

choices.label: Accept your fate

nodes.title: Goblin Road
nodes.text: Halfway up the mountain, three goblins drop from the trees, daggers drawn!

choices.label: Swing the Dragonbane Lance at them!

nodes.title: Goblin Road
nodes.text: Halfway up the mountain, three goblins drop from the trees, daggers drawn!

choices.label: Let them stab you

nodes.title: Goblin Road
nodes.text: Halfway up the mountain, three goblins drop from the trees.

choices.label: Hide behind Bronn

nodes.title: Goblin Road
nodes.text: Halfway up the mountain, three goblins drop from the trees. You have no armor, no lance, and a hangover.

choices.label: Throw your coin purse at them as a distraction and sprint past!

nodes.title: Dragon's Maw
nodes.text: You vaporized the goblins with one swing. You stand before the yawning, sulfur-smelling cave of the Dreadwyrm. You are armed with a weapon of mass destruction.

choices.label: Charge in screaming to finish this

nodes.title: Dragon's Maw
nodes.text: Their daggers broke against your flame-retardant armor. They ran away. You stand before the cave, encased in heavy steel.

choices.label: Clank your way inside

nodes.title: Dragon's Maw
nodes.text:
Bronn decapitates all three in five seconds. He wipes his blade. "Alright, let's kill a lizard."

You enter the cave.

choices.label: Tell Bronn to attack the sleeping beast

nodes.title: Dragon's Maw
nodes.text: You are broke, unarmored, and terrified. But you made it to the cave. The dragon is asleep on a massive pile of treasure.

choices.label: Try to sneak in and steal a single gem to prove you were here
Trip over a fucking stalagmite

nodes.title: The Final Showdown
nodes.text: The dragon roars, rearing back to breathe a pillar of hellfire. You panic.

choices.label: Throw the Lance at its stupid face!

nodes.title: Oven Baked
nodes.text: The dragon wakes up. It breathes fire. Your flame-retardant armor protects you from the flames, but the metal instantly heats up to 500 degrees.

choices.label: Oh no

nodes.title: Betrayal
nodes.text: Bronn looks at the size of the dragon. He looks back at you. "Yeah, no. I'm not fighting that."

choices.label: "I'll double your pay!"
Run away!

nodes.title: Kick the Chicken
nodes.text: "I've got a better idea," Bronn says. He kicks you square in the back, sending you tumbling into the dragon's nose. The beast wakes up. Bronn sprints out with your gold.

choices.label: Beg for mercy

nodes.title: The Thief
nodes.text: You successfully pocket a diamond the size of your head. The dragon snores on.

choices.label: Tiptoe out and walk back to the docks

nodes.title: Awakened
nodes.text: The noise echoes. A massive, reptilian eye snaps open. You stare down the gullet of an apex predator.

choices.label: Cry

nodes.title: ENDING: THE CELL
nodes.text:
You are thrown into the Royal Dungeons for fraud and treason. You spend the rest of your life eating moldy bread and telling the rats about how you totally survived a dragon once.

(BAD END)

nodes.title: ENDING: EXTRA CRISPY
nodes.text:
You are incinerated instantly. The King builds a beautiful statue in your honor, entirely unaware you died screaming and crying.

(DEATH END)

nodes.title: ENDING: THE CANON LEGEND
nodes.text:
You throw the Dragonbane Lance like a javelin. It misses the dragon entirely, bounces off the cave wall, and shatters a load-bearing stalactite. The entire cave roof collapses, crushing the dragon instantly.

You crawl out of the rubble, completely unharmed. The realm hails you as the greatest warrior in history. You hate your life.

(TRUE END)

nodes.title: ENDING: PINA COLADAS
nodes.text:
You take the gold/diamond and sail across the world. You open a beachside tavern in the Summer Isles. Sometimes you hear rumors of a dragon burning down your old kingdom, but frankly, that sounds like a 'them' problem.

(SECRET END)
